## Statutory Guides & Consumer Law Regulations
- [Experience Letter Not Given by Employer? Legal Action](https://www.legalrecovery.in/experience-letter-not-given-legal-action): Statutory guide on employer refusal of experience certificates, Model Standing Orders Rule 16/17, Article 21 livelihood rights, and advocate legal notices.
- [Bonus or Incentive Not Received: Mail to HR (Template)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/bonus-incentive-not-received-mail): Email templates for unpaid bonus, sales incentive, variable pay or commission, including after resignation, with Section 17(2) Code on Wages and Contract Act Section 73 references.
- [Notice Period Recovery Calculator: Basic vs Gross Pay](https://www.legalrecovery.in/tools/notice-period-recovery-calculator): Interactive legal tool computing notice-period shortfall recovery on basic pay vs gross salary, identifying illegal employer over-deductions under Section 74 Indian Contract Act.
- [Gratuity Calculator India 2026 (Incl. Fixed-Term Rule)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/tools/gratuity-calculator): Statutory gratuity calculator using the 15/26 formula, fixed-term 1-year eligibility rule under Section 53(2) Code on Social Security, and Section 7(3A) 10% penal delay interest.
- [Full & Final Settlement Calculator (India, 2026)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/tools/full-and-final-settlement-calculator): Free interactive FnF calculator computing unpaid salary, leave encashment, gratuity, and notice period recovery under Section 17(2) Code on Wages.
- [Full & Final Settlement Not Received? Copy This Email to HR](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/fnf-not-received-mail-to-hr): A firm, legally worded email template to HR for delayed FnF dues with a 7-day deadline and Code on Wages references.
- [Relieving / Experience Letter Request Email: Templates](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/relieving-experience-letter-request-email): Polite, firm, and final pre-litigation email templates to request a relieving or experience letter, with Model Standing Orders and Article 21 legal references.
- [Salary Delay Complaint Letter to HR: Free Format](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/salary-delay-complaint-letter-to-hr): Ready salary-delay complaint letters and email templates to HR or management with Section 17(1) Code on Wages references, 3-tone variants, and Word/PDF formats.
- [Salary Payment Deadline in India: The 7th-of-Month Rule](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/code-on-wages-salary-payment-deadline): Statutory guide explaining Section 17(1) Code on Wages 2019, 7th-of-the-month salary deadline, employer default liabilities, and Section 45 Labour Authority recovery remedies.
- [DGCA Air Ticket Refund Rules 2026: 48-Hour Cancellation & Deadlines](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/dgca-air-ticket-refund-rules-2026): Statutory guide on revised DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part II, 48-hour free look-in option, 7-day payment mode deadlines, and airline liability for travel agent defaults.
- [E-Commerce Rules 2020 & 2026 Amendment: Your Refund Rights](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/ecommerce-rules-grievance-officer-48-hours): Statutory guide explaining e-commerce grievance officer duties, 48-hour acknowledgment, one-month resolution, dark-pattern compliance, and marketplace liability.
- [Dark Patterns Guidelines India: Refund & Consumer Rights](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/dark-patterns-guidelines-consumer-rights): Comprehensive guide to India's 13 banned dark patterns, drip pricing illegality, subscription traps, CCPA complaints, and refund recovery rights.

## Consumer Problem & Refund Tracing Guides
- [Flight Delay & Cancellation Compensation in India (Slabs)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/flight-delay-cancellation-compensation-india): Statutory guide to DGCA compensation slabs for cancelled flights, long delays, and denied boarding, with escalation steps when airlines refuse.
- [Refund Successful but Not Received? Trace It With UTR/ARN](https://www.legalrecovery.in/refund-shows-successful-but-not-received): Actionable guide to trace uncredited e-commerce refunds using UTR and ARN codes, resolve bank suspense ledgers, and enforce RBI delay compensation.
- [Refund as Gift Card or Wallet Only: Is It Legal in India?](https://www.legalrecovery.in/refund-as-gift-card-or-wallet-legal): Statutory guide on forced store credits, RBI source account reversal rules, CCPA Dark Patterns bans, and advocate notice escalation.
- [Visa Agent Took Money, No Visa? Refund & Legal Action](https://www.legalrecovery.in/visa-agent-fraud-refund-legal-notice): Statutory guide on recovering immigration consultant fees, voiding non-refundable contract clauses under Section 2(46) CPA 2019, Section 318 BNS cheating FIRs, and advocate legal notices.
- [Credit Shell or Voucher Instead of Refund: Can You Refuse?](https://www.legalrecovery.in/credit-shell-voucher-instead-of-refund-legal): Comprehensive legal guide on refusing forced airline credit shells and travel vouchers under Supreme Court directives and DGCA CAR rules, demanding full cash refund with interest.
